learned.description: Injects missing rate-limit and budget guardrails to prevent runaway retry storms and force controlled shutdowns.
Detects and force-clears port collisions then verifies bind before respawning dependent tmux windows.
learned.example: ss -tlnp | grep PORT && lsof -ti:PORT | xargs -r kill -9; sleep 1; python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1); s.bind(('', PORT)); print('bind ok'); s.close()" && tmux respawn-window -t SESSION

findings.summary: Critical unbounded retry storm due to missing guardrails and stalled workers; inject rate-limits and verify port binds, then respawn.
Unbounded budget and missing guardrails triggered 4874 task failures in ~11.5h; injecting max_tasks/max_hours/timeouts and respawning to enforce controlled shutdown.
Missing budget guardrails allowed unbounded retry storms; inject limits and respawn to enforce controlled shutdown and reset state.
Critical runaway retry storm from unbounded budget and missing guardrails; inject limits and respawn to throttle and stabilize.
Unbounded budget and missing rate limits triggered a catastrophic failure cascade requiring immediate guardrail injection and session respawn to halt the storm.
Critical runaway failure storm in ps5-hive due to unbounded budget and missing timeout, requiring immediate config guardrails and respawn.
Missing config timeout and port/service contention causing cascading task failures—resolved via config injection, port clearing, and window respawn.
ps5-hive suffers from missing task_timeout config and port/lock contention causing mass task failures; fix applies config, clears port 8080, and respawns the window.
Missing timeout config triggered watchdog resets and task cascade failure; inject default and respawn to stabilize.
Missing task_timeout config triggered repeated 1800s worker timeouts leading to mass failures; extend timeout and respawn.
Two hive-ui sessions have port conflicts (8888/8889) and one session has insufficient task timeout; fixes clear ports and safely bump timeout with respawns.
Two sessions have port collisions on 8888/8889 killing logstream workers; one session has undersized task_timeout causing worker timeouts.
Missing researcher list and undersized task_timeout caused idle loops and worker timeouts; config-default-apply applied to stabilize sessions.
Fix missing researcher config in hive-dev/hive-live and increase task_timeout to 7200s in ps5-hive to prevent worker timeouts.
Three sessions failing: two from empty researcher config, one from worker timeout with extreme failure ratio.
Port conflict on 8889 blocks hive-dev; hive-live and ps5-hive stalled on missing configuration and empty input respectively.
Port collision on hive-dev, config starvation in hive-live, and queue exhaustion with skewed success ratio in ps5-hive require respawns plus bind/config hygiene.
Port conflicts on 8888/8889 are preventing logstream.py from binding; clear collisions and verify binds before respawning windows.
Port conflicts on 8888/8889 blocking logstream.py; clear collisions and verify binds before respawning windows.
Port collisions on 8888/8889 stall logstream workers; researcher-tracker idle from missing configuration.
Port collisions on 8888/8889 are blocking logstream.py; clear conflicts and respawn windows to restore service.
Port conflicts on 8888/8889 are blocking logstream services; clear collisions and respawn windows to restore streams.
Duplicate port conflicts on 8888/8889 prevent logstream.py from launching in both sessions.
Port conflicts on 8888/8889 are triggering repeated logstream.py respawns and cascading session errors.
Port collisions on 8888/8889 are triggering respawn storms in both sessions; clearing bindings and pre-flight testing restores normal operation.
Port conflicts on 8888/8889 are triggering endless respawn loops in both sessions.
Port collisions on 8888 and 8889 are blocking logstream respawns in both monitored sessions, requiring force-clear and respawn.
Port collisions on 8888/8889 prevent logstream respawns in both sessions; researcher-tracker idle states are secondary.
Both sessions stuck in respawn loops due to lingering port bindings; clear ports, confirm availability, then respawn windows.
Both sessions show repeated port conflicts on 8888/8889 causing logstream restart loops; clear collisions and respawn.
Port collision or missing resource causes repeated logstream crashes in both hive-dev and hive-live.
Port collisions and missing config are driving crash loops in two sessions.

solutions.problem: worker qwen3.6-abliterated-q3km timing out after 1800s with high failure rate (4874 failed vs 60 done)
solutions.solution: tmux send-keys -t ps5-hive 'cat ~/.hive/config | grep -q timeout || echo "task_timeout=3600" >> ~/.hive/config && tmux respawn-window -t ps5-hive' Enter

solutions.problem: Task queue drained with high failure ratio (4874 failed vs 60 done); synthesis triggered despite no files analyzed — likely stale state or upstream source exhaustion.
solutions.solution: tmux send-keys -t ps5-hive 'tmux respawn-window -t ps5-hive' Enter && sleep 2 && tmux capture-pane -t ps5-hive -p | tail -5

orchestrator_sessions.goal: Solidify hive-ui production readiness by adding resilient metrics, auth guardrails, and real-time stream stability for all active sessions.
orchestrator_sessions.summary: The hive is running at full health with nine active sessions and the new Ling model serving inferences. The Next.js UI is live on port 3001 with GitHub auth and SSE streaming, but lacks server-side resilience and observable metrics for session health.
orchestrator_sessions.progress: Wired inclusionai/ling-2.6-1t:free as the active text model and exposed the full 12-route Next.js UI with GitHub auth and SSE on port 3001.

Add exponential backoff and jitter retry logic to lib/sse.ts sendStream() when HTTP 429/503 is returned and cap retries at 5 with 2^retry * 100ms base delay.
Add auth middleware to middleware.ts that validates session cookie against NEXTAUTH_SECRET and injects user.role into request.locals before route handlers.
Add unit tests for lib/sse.ts covering all retry conditions (200, 429, 503, network error) using mocked fetch and timers in tests/sse.test.ts.
Add build-time env validation to scripts/validateEnv.ts that asserts required keys (NEXTAUTH_SECRET, GITHUB_CLIENT_ID, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, LING_MODEL) and exits non-zero on missing/invalid values.
decisions: Lock default model to inclusionai/ling-2.6-1t:free for text generation across all sessions unless explicitly overridden via session metadata.
Enforce GitHub OAuth as mandatory auth provider for hive-ui routes and reject unauthenticated requests at middleware.
Route all session metrics through /api/metrics with 10s in-memory retention window to avoid store bloat and ensure low-latency visibility.
